title: Contents Packout & Storage Coverage Rider for Crated Art, Mirrors and Glass
content:
Rider schedule for Contents Packout & Storage declared-value coverage on Partial Contents Packout and Full Contents Packout jobs. Crated art, mirrors and glass carry a coverage rider: **when the crate quantities on the job's packout lines total at least the crate rider threshold, the large crate rider is added to the valuation percentage; when they total at least one crate but fewer than the crate rider threshold, the small crate rider is added; a job with no crate on its packout lines carries no crate rider.**

| Crates on the job's packout lines | Rider added to the valuation percentage |
|---|---|
| 4 or more (at least the crate rider threshold) | 0.08 (large crate rider) |
| 1 to 3 | 0.05 (small crate rider) |
| none | none |

The crates counted are the quantities on the custom crate packing lines booked on the job; the rider is in percent of the value covered, like the valuation percentage.

**Boundary cases.** 3 crates: 0.05. 4 crates: 0.08. No crate line: no rider.
